paragraphs: The Maybach S680 is the pinnacle of the S-Class range, powered by a 6.0-litre twin-turbo V12. Introduced in 2021 for the Z223 generation, it continues a long Mercedes tradition of V12 luxury flagships. The engine represents the highest level of complexity and cost in the S-Class line-up, with components and labour costs reflecting its bespoke nature. The Maybach S680 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every MAYBACH S680 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the MAYBACH S680 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The Maybach S680's V12 engine is unique to the Z223 generation. Fitting an engine from a different model, or even a different S-Class variant, would be incompatible due to significant differences in mounting, electronics, and ECU calibration. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
